messages:
maria: Heads-up — last-minute critical fix in PR #7893 that blocks the hotfix train. Need 2x approvals before today's 17:00 UTC cutoff. TL;DR: kv-cache edge-case causing OOM on long contexts; patch adds a guard + unit test. CI mostly green; one flaky macos e2e failing (seems unrelated). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/repo/pull/7893

release-bot: Reminder: hotfix cutoff at 17:00 UTC. Ensure required checks pass and have 2 approvers listed.

alex: I'll take a pass now. @sam can you spare a quick second-eye in the next 45m?

sam: Yep, I'll review and run a quick perf smoke by 16:30 UTC. Any specific things to watch for besides cache logic?

maria: Thanks — main things: 1) eviction logic (no accidental double-free), 2) perf regression (run `make perf-local` or `./scripts/smoke_perf.sh`), 3) the new unit test covers the reproduced sequence.

jin: Left two tiny nits in the PR thread — non-blocking. One question about a log message, pinged @alex to sanity-check.

alex: Saw jin's comments. I'll run the unit tests + `make perf-local` now and report back. If everything matches, I'll approve.

sam: Quick Q: can we merge if the macos-e2e job is failing? CI shows "macos-e2e" failing due to setup flakiness.

release-bot: Policy note: required checks for this train are unit-tests, linux-e2e, and perf-smoke. macos-e2e is optional for the hotfix exemption. See https://go.redwood/release-exemptions for details.

maria: Great — so we just need 2 LGTMs + required checks green. @alex @sam please drop LGTM once you confirm. If both are in by 16:45 UTC I'll queue the merge. Rollback plan: revert PR and pin previous model-search index; will notify infra to roll back capacity if needed.

alex: LGTM — ran unit tests and perf smoke locally, no regression on my machine.

sam: LGTM from me as well; left one optional suggestion in the PR. I'll be available to monitor post-merge smoke. Merging around ~16:50 unless any objections.

release-bot: Merge queued by maria. Post-merge smoke checks will run automatically and report status in the PR.

maria: Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turnaround :tada:
